Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • OSHA Lockout Tagout (LOTO) Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.147.
  • Arc Flash Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024): in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910 Subpart S and 29 CFR 1926 Subpart K.
  • Electrical Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024): in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910 Subpart S and 29 CFR 1926 Subpart K.
  • OSHA Ground Fault Protection/GFCI Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024): in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926 Subpart K, 29 CFR 1910 Subpart S, CAL/OSHA 2405.4(c) & 2405.4(d), and NFPA 70E 2024 Standards.
  • OSHA-ANSI Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Certificate Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.147, ANSI/ASSP Z244.1-2024, and NFPA 70E-2024.
How long does NFPA 70E Electrical Safety, Arc Flash & Lockout/Tagout Training take?
  • OSHA Lockout Tagout (LOTO) Training: 1 hour.
  • Radiofrequency (RF) Safety and Hazard Awareness Training: 1 hour.
  • Arc Flash Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024): 2 hours.
  • Electrical Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024): 3 hours.
  • OSHA Ground Fault Protection/GFCI Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024): 1 hour.
  • OSHA-ANSI Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Certificate Training: 3 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • OSHA Lockout Tagout (LOTO) Training: valid 36 months
  • Radiofrequency (RF) Safety and Hazard Awareness Training: valid 36 months
  • Arc Flash Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024): valid 36 months
  • Electrical Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024): valid 36 months
  • OSHA Ground Fault Protection/GFCI Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024): valid 36 months
  • OSHA-ANSI Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Certificate Training: valid 12 months
Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

These courses are available in English and Spanish:

  • OSHA Lockout Tagout (LOTO) Training
  • Arc Flash Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024)
  • Electrical Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024)
  • OSHA Ground Fault Protection/GFCI Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2024)

The others are in English.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
